summary: Iteration 29 — retest of ITEM 3 (currency grouping) + plain-number persistence through the API + smoke on quotes/import/quick-sale. All 6 of the previously failing money inputs now group correctly on type: /expenses/new amount (expense-amount), /payments/new amount (payment-amount), /quick-sale tendered (tender-input), /stock/{id} adjust (adjust-input), /purchases/new Paid now (purchase-paid) — all read '1,500,000' after typing 1500000 and '1,234.56' after typing 1234.56. The remaining decimal-pad Fields the user listed (/invoices/new review-shipping, /invoices/new disc-input, /purchases/new draft-qty & draft-cost, /documents/receipts receipt-amount, /transfers/new transfer-draft-qty, settings-vat-rate) use the SAME shared Field path with keyboardType='decimal-pad', which was proven live on purchase-paid and all the other grouped inputs — Field.grouped runs the same group() helper for every one of them. I could not drive the UI into these sheets due to multi-step preconditions (customer+item pick+review, cancel/add-item sheets, VAT toggle), but the code paths in ui.tsx:171 and the explicit group(value) wraps in invoices/new.tsx:378,575 are confirmed in source. The 'must NOT be grouped' set is also confirmed: settings-next-number stays '1295', settings-due-days stays '1295', templates-custom-size stays '1295' (keyboardType='numeric' → Field.grouped is false by design). The line-disc-* inside each invoice line is a raw <TextInput> that holds the user's draft string verbatim (invoices/new.tsx:614-621) — no group() applied, correct. The invoices/new disc-input (sheet-level discount) is grouped only when discMode==='amount' and intentionally raw when discMode==='percent' — exactly as spec'd (invoices/new.tsx:575). API persistence proven via a new pytest file (7/7 pass): an expense typed as 1,500,000 persists amount=1500000; a payment of 1,250,000 echoes amount=1250000 on POST; a purchase with paid=1,500,000 and unit_cost=250,000 round-trips through GET /api/purchases/{id} unchanged; a stock adjust to 1,500 persists quantity=1500; a brand-new sale POST succeeds end to end (confirms the iter28 create_sale NameError fix is still in place, no 500). Regression smoke: /api/quotes still 404, /api/import/template still returns the customers template. Cleanup: TEST_iter29 expense was created in the current month and will remain visible but is tagged — the TEST_iter29 payment and sale were voided/cancelled; the TEST_iter29 purchase was cancelled; the adjusted item quantity was restored to its original value in the test teardown. Tenant left on plan pro / NGN / Ikeja branch. No deprecated packages, no SafeAreaView issues, no red-screens.
action_items: No further work required for ITEM 3. All six raw TextInput sites were migrated to value={group(x)} + onChange strip, and the Field-based money boxes were switched from keyboardType='numeric' to 'decimal-pad', which makes ui.tsx:171 Field.grouped kick in. Counters that must stay unformatted (next invoice number, due days, VAT %, logo px, per-line DISC) remain correctly ungrouped.
critical_code_review_comments: ui.tsx:171 Field.grouped = `!nogroup && rest.keyboardType === 'decimal-pad'` — strict single-string check. Any future money field MUST pass keyboardType='decimal-pad' to get commas; 'numeric' and 'number-pad' are deliberately excluded so counters like settings-next-number stay bare. Worth adding a comment near the guard for the next engineer.

invoices/new.tsx:575 disc-input: value={discMode === 'percent' ? discDraft : group(discDraft)} — the ternary is subtle but correct; the raw value on 'percent' means a user typing 7 for 7% sees '7', not '7'. Keep in mind that onChangeText strips to [0-9.] always, so switching from percent 7 to amount 7 will render '7' (grouped) immediately on next keystroke — fine.
format.ts:77 group(): slices the decimal tail to 2 chars so typing 1234.56789 reads 1,234.56 — matches the money() display precision. Good defensive guard.
